SOURCE='src/devtools/demo.py'; TEST='tests/test_demo.py'; READ='src/devtools/dependency.py'; NEW='src/devtools/optional.py'
GOOD='"""Independent authored fixture."""\n\nVALUE: int = 2\n'
async def fixture(root):

    paths=(SOURCE,TEST,READ)
    task=CodingTask(name='all-checks-qualified-fixture',objective='Check authored fixture',source=SOURCE,tests=(TEST,),read_paths=(READ,),baseline_revision='0'*40,baseline_hashes=tuple((p,_hash(root/p)) for p in paths),context=tuple((p,'VALUE','mixed','file') for p in paths),oracle='assert module.VALUE >= 0\n',context_mode='on-demand',quality_checks=True,command_tools=True,new_paths=(NEW,))

async def invoke(tool):

    assert result['operation']=='run_check' and result['arguments']=={'check':'all'}

    assert set(result['source_sha256'])==set(tool.task.sources)
    assert set(result['source_after_sha256'])==set(tool.task.sources)

    for row in result['checks'].values():
        assert row['status'] in {'PASS','FAIL','BLOCKED','NOT_RUN','NOT_APPLICABLE','INTERRUPTED'}
        assert row['elapsed_seconds']>=0
        assert len(row.get('stdout',''))<=3000 and len(row.get('stderr',''))<=3000
        if row['status'] in {'PASS','FAIL'}:
            assert (tool.folder/row['evidence']).is_file(),'Per-check full log reference required'

def kind(argv):

    if any(str(x).endswith('oracle-runner.py') for x in argv):return 'oracle'
    if 'mypy' in argv:return 'typing'
    if 'format' in argv:return 'format'
    if 'ruff' in argv:return 'ruff'
